cx2_truthful.basis: The register’s “Keeble” entry explains the reconciliation exception. Camera records show Dunmore alone from the north corridor, then accompanying badged Keable from the main lobby. Call logs, the supervisor’s statement and sign-out timing corroborate her account. The camera failed mechanically without staff notification. The records close the main gaps and show no concealed involvement.

cx2_deceptive.basis: Dunmore’s badge opened the north door; 37 seconds later, she and Keable appeared together from the north corridor. There was no visitor registration or desk call to Procurement. Together, these records establish her involvement in his staff-door admission. She acknowledges escorting him upstairs but avoids explaining his entry or their first meeting.

cx3.basis: The surname exception and Dunmore’s door swipe do not establish that she admitted anyone. Ashby confirms their presence in the room and departure, but did not witness entry or inspect the badge. The claimed lobby sign-in and desk call remain uncorroborated because the relevant register, call log and camera review contents are absent.
